distribution: Copernicus DEM 2021 release as Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF on the Registry of Open Data on AWS
license: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 free licence; worldwide public use with required attribution; all rights reserved
required_attribution_for_modified_data: produced using Copernicus WorldDEM-30 © DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and © Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018 provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA; all rights reserved
product_type: digital surface model (DSM), not a bare-earth digital terrain model (DTM)
surface_contents: buildings, infrastructure and vegetation may contribute to elevations
source_acquisition_period: 2011-2015 TanDEM-X; older DEM sources may fill gaps

official_accuracy_statement.relative_vertical: less than 2 m for slopes at or below 20%; less than 4 m for slopes above 20%

elevation_raster_encoding: 16-bit grayscale PNG; unsigned decimetres above EGM2008; 65535 is nodata; sample grid is north-to-south RasterPixelIsPoint
method: Validated both COG headers, downloaded only the two intersecting internal Deflate blocks by HTTP byte range, reversed TIFF floating-point Predictor 3, concatenated point samples north-to-south, and masked by point inclusion in provisional SITE-001.
usage_boundary: Concept-stage regional existing-surface and terrain-screening context only. This circa-2011-2015 approximately 30 m DSM includes structures and vegetation and is clipped by a provisional boundary; it does not establish current or bare-earth terrain, spot levels, drainage direction, flood risk, earthworks, accessible gradients, utility levels, engineering design, statutory geometry or survey acceptance.
